subject: New DataTable Error for Already Deployed Application on shinyapps.io

messages.author: 089f75accdf54dd2
messages.subject: New DataTable Error for Already Deployed Application on shinyapps.io
parts:
I have an application that has been deployed on shinyapps.io for several months at https://dwahman.shinyapps.io/Unified-Combo/ without problem.

As part of the application and after running a simulation, a DataTable is generated to summarize the initial conditions for the simulation.

Within the last week, I am now receiving an error as follows:  "DataTables warning:  table id = DataTables_Table_0 - ajax error"

As mentioned above, this application has been deployed on shinyapps.io and working without generating this error for several months and only recently started having this error.

If I look at my log in the shinyapps.io dashboard, I am also now getting the following "Error in if (q$search[["value"]] != "") { : argument is of length zero"

Could the recent update to shinyapps.io be the cause for this as nothing else has changed?  I am trying to figure out what would have changed to impact an already deployed application and looking for any help on this matter.

Thank you in advance.

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] New DataTable Error for Already Deployed Application on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi David,

Thanks a lot for the report. It is very helpful that you provided the
error message from R. I have seen the Ajax error being reported for
about ten times, and I have never figured out what really went wrong
since I was unable to reproduce it. With your help, I think I have got
the fix. Could you test the current development version?

devtools::install_github("rstudio/shiny")

In the mean time, we have actually deprecated DataTables in shiny, and
I'd recommend you to try the DT package when you can:
http://rstudio.github.io/DT/

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name
